purpose: Teach: 洋子/四郎/敦/小僧/無題/赤色/紗子/和子

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんのお友達洋子さんがよく我が家に来られた
lines.en: You know, when you were young, your father's friend Youko used to visit us all the time.
lines.style: Gentle, inviting memory. Soft opening. Slow pace, as if pulling something precious from deep storage. Warm curiosity — not quite asking a question, but leaving space for her to join in.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、四郎兄さんと将棋を指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes, and didn't your father play shogi with your brother Shiro?
lines.style: Delighted recognition. Quick warm smile in the voice. The pleasure of a shared memory confirmed. Slight lift on the recall — she's been waiting for this thread to be picked up.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお孫の敦くんを膝に乗せられた
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, your father used to sit your grandson Atsushi right on his lap.
lines.style: The same wistful invitation. Slower this time, more deliberate. Like he's testing whether she'll remember this specific moment. Tender underneath, almost protective of the image.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、子供達を「小僧」と親しみを込めて呼ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and didn't he call all the children 'little rascals' in that fond way of his?
lines.style: Swift, knowing warmth. The affectionate teasing note in her voice — she's remembering exactly how he'd say it. A soft laugh underneath the words, not quite breaking through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは絵に敢えて無題と署名された
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, your father signed his paintings with no title at all.
lines.style: Same unhurried wistfulness. This detail hangs heavier somehow. His voice slows a fraction more. The weight of an artistic gesture she would understand. Patient, letting the image settle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、赤色の傘を愛用されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes, and didn't you use to always carry that red umbrella of yours?
lines.style: A small turn — this detail is hers now, not his father's. Slightly teasing affection. Warm recognition that she remembers his small habits as clearly as he remembers his father's. A moment of gentle equality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがご姪の紗子さんを可愛がられた
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, your father absolutely doted on your niece Sachiko.
lines.style: Same patient wistfulness, but warmer now. The mention of affection softens his voice almost imperceptibly. A quiet acknowledgment of love passed down. Unhurried, steady.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、お姉様の和子さんと文通されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and when you were young, didn't you exchange letters with your sister Kazuko?
lines.style: Gentle, knowing warmth. A softer landing than before — this is more intimate, more personal. She's remembering something that mattered. The affection is quieter, more private. A small fade at the end, as if treasuring the thought.
